notes: Strip a: x 0-2440 plus ~300 px overlap (checked to 2740). Vine Street forms the plate's west edge: NE diagonal from the top apex down to Glenmary, curving east along y~3650, then SE past the Zoo and south from y~5050 at x~2093. Most of Vine's NW/W side is the plate edge, so cross streets on that side appear only as short stubs; unlabelled stubs named where plate 38 picks give a name (Woolper, Ruther), else '?'. West Street: printed 'WEST' at x~900 and 'ST.' at x~2000 with nothing between; it may be an abbreviated longer name. Glenmary is printed 'GLENMARRY AVE.' on this plate. Forest Avenue: E-W 40 ft segment from Vine to Duluth (no label), then SE, ESE (label FOREST), SSE (label AVE.) and E along the Zoo's north side. Irving Street's curved north section from Ehrman is unlabelled. Tallant is labelled only east of Irving. The Zoological Garden interior paths are not streets. Euclid Avenue (x~2820) lies just outside the overlap and was not picked.
